questions.question: How does Proverbs 20 describe wine and strong drink?
options: Wine is a good medicine for the weary
Wine is altogether harmless to all the wise
Wine is a rich blessing from the LORD
Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler
questions.answer: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler

questions.question: What does Proverbs 20 say even a child is known by?
options: His family and the good name that he was born to
His wealth and all the many riches of his great house
His acts, whether his conduct is pure and upright
His age and the long years that he has lived on earth
questions.answer: His acts, whether his conduct is pure and upright

questions.question: Proverbs 20 says a false balance is hated, but a just weight is the LORD's delight (the LORD detests unequal weights).
_____ is a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.
Even a child makes himself known by his acts, by whether his conduct is _____ and upright.
